contract: Corroborates actual frozen primary question context+serialized request hashes; exact source/projection/copied ranges; ordered J125-compatible map SHA/count streamed past bounded prefix. Optional known metadata selection/body/extraction must match actual loose source; absent/hashless legacy refs remain unknown. Known extraction needs actual matching whole-body output and selected part. BatchIntent validates offered receipt against actual question and payload, including malformed primary meta refusing union fallback.
exclusions: No block/physical origin or exclusion inference
No paid/source/body archive or new storage
No claim of old-reader preserving unknown new receipt field
Pure builder binds the offered frozen context and request pair; it does not rerender or parse provider-specific prompt content
future_writer_seams: AnalysisService._prepare after _fit_to_budget and the single backend.prepare_request; original loaded.selection before fit +actual fitted.projection and admitted current parents
Caller _accept_preparation/_enqueue persists parents and optional metadata in existing transaction; no re-prepare/rekey/new submitter
rollback_limitation: Old exact28 reader ignores/drops prospective optional receipt on rewrite, preserving request/payload/binding/business metadata; absent None JSON is exact. Reader deploy must precede producer. Snapshot preservation/compatible reader required when retaining newly emitted receipts across rollback.
scope: INERT reader and pure builder only; no runtime caller/writer, provider bytes, paid IDs, schema, projections or backend changes.
